$ edit b/corpus_test.go  # a package b over the corpus
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # transforms
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    script/errs/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base's do/ tree already errs
    script/garbled/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base states malformed, which looped neither gives nor keeps
    script/garbled/transform/upper: upper declines the base: the base states malformed, which upper neither gives nor keeps
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs/echo
            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/script/errs/transform/looped
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs/transform/upper
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs/transform/upper/echo
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/garbled
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/garbled/echo
            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/script/garbled/transform/looped
            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/script/garbled/transform/upper

            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/echo

                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/transform/looped/echo

                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/transform/upper/echo

$ edit testdata/script/twice.txtar  # lay a file over looped's view below the base's values.txt
$ go test  # transforms
    script/errs/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base's do/ tree already errs
    script/garbled/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base states malformed, which looped neither gives nor keeps
    script/garbled/transform/upper: upper declines the base: the base states malformed, which upper neither gives nor keeps
    script/twice/transform/looped: Adds do/error and resolve/error, so echo and resolve err as on a cycle.
        The archive's inputs for looped's variant are invalid, and no cell runs on them:
          transform/looped: the variant's input view holds do/out/values.txt, and do/out/values.txt/x below it
        The module's update, FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., rewrites them, in the package that owns looped.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs

            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/script/errs/transform/looped
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs/transform/upper
                --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/errs/transform/upper/echo
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/garbled
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/garbled/echo
            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/script/garbled/transform/looped
            --- SKIP: TestCorpus/script/garbled/transform/upper

$ go test ./b  # tr-b
    script/errs/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base's do/ tree already errs
    script/garbled/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base states malformed, which looped neither gives nor keeps
    script/garbled/transform/upper: upper declines the base: the base states malformed, which upper neither gives nor keeps
    script/twice/transform/looped: Adds do/error and resolve/error, so echo and resolve err as on a cycle.
        The archive's inputs for looped's variant are invalid, and no cell runs on them:
          transform/looped: the variant's input view holds do/out/values.txt, and do/out/values.txt/x below it
        The module's update, FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., rewrites them, in the package that owns looped. If no package owns looped, the root-package check says so, and no update rewrites them.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus

    script/garbled/transform/looped: looped declines the base: the base states malformed, which looped neither gives nor keeps
    script/garbled/transform/upper: upper declines the base: the base states malformed, which upper neither gives nor keeps
    script/twice/transform/looped: Adds do/error and resolve/error, so echo and resolve err as on a cycle.
        The archive's inputs for looped's variant are invalid, and no cell runs on them:
          transform/looped/delete: the section is empty; a variant that removes nothing has no delete section
        The module's update, FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., rewrites them, in the package that owns looped.
